sn36.24:1.1: me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etad ahosi || ||
sn36.24:1.2: Katamā nu kho vedanā || katamo vedanāsamudayo katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā || katamo vedanānirodho katamā vedanānirodhagāminī patipadā ||
sn36.24:1.3: ko vedanāya assādo ko ādīnavo kiṃ nissaraṇan ti || || 3
sn36.24:1.6: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.24:1.10: Yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgapahānam idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇanti || || 4
